_comment: Per-MACHINE OLED/rotary/MCP pin overrides (BCM numbers). Copy to config/hardware.json and keep ONLY the keys your board changes; anything omitted uses the defaults in src/sable/hardware.py (the standard Quadify wiring: OLED DC=24, RST=25, CS=CE0). This describes physical WIRING -- not a user setting, never shown in the menu/web UI. config/hardware.json is gitignored (one per machine).
_when_you_need_this: Only if your board is NOT the standard pinout. The original EVO Sabre unit is wired DC=GPIO27, RST=GPIO24 -- the oled block below is exactly that override; copy this file to config/hardware.json on an EVO unit.
_led_reverse_note: Set mcp.led_reverse=true ONLY if the LED ribbon cable is plugged in REVERSED -- i.e. play/pause light the BOTTOM two LEDs instead of the top two. It flips the LED order end-to-end in software (GPIOA only; buttons are unaffected). Standard boards: omit this / leave false.
